title: Your First Weekend at Florida Gulf Coast University, Shared as Cards
description: A practical, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence built around ten named FGCU places and recurring campus activities.

cards.title: Start with campus directions
cards.subtitle: Cohen Student Union, first floor
cards.notes: Stop at the first-floor Information Booth to pick up a university map, ask for directions, and check what is happening in the building.
cards.short_summary: A useful first orientation stop inside FGCU’s student union.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says its Cohen Student Union Information Booth provides university maps, directions, general university information, and lost-and-found service.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Cohen Student Union’s first floor; consult the union page for current building hours.

cards.title: Reserve a study-room session
cards.subtitle: FGCU Library
cards.notes: Use the library’s space-booking page with your FGCU email, then bring your own device for a focused planning or catch-up session.
cards.short_summary: A bookable campus study stop for current FGCU students.
cards.evidence_claim: The FGCU Library’s booking page states that study rooms are for current FGCU students, faculty, and staff and require an FGCU email.
cards.source_title: Book a Space in the Library | Florida Gulf Coast University Library
cards.access_notes: Book ahead through the library’s system; an FGCU email is required.

cards.title: Walk the student-run Food Forest
cards.subtitle: Near Sugden Welcome Center and Kleist Health Center
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk through the edible garden and use the plant-identification material to learn what is growing before you leave campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-run botanical garden open from sunrise to sunset.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU describes the Food Forest as a student-run botanical garden, open to the community sunrise to sunset, and a free resource.
cards.access_notes: FGCU places it just past Sugden Welcome Center, beside Kleist Health Center; visit only during its stated sunrise-to-sunset access.

cards.title: Get familiar with the waterfront
cards.subtitle: North Lake Village, Lake Como
cards.notes: If you hold an eligible Eagle ID and membership, check in with waterfront staff and use only the supervised areas and permitted equipment.
cards.short_summary: FGCU’s designated student swimming and sunbathing area.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies the Waterfront at Lake Como as its designated student swimming and sunbathing area and offers free equipment checkout with an eligible Eagle ID and recreation membership.
cards.access_notes: Current students or eligible members only; swim during posted, lifeguard-supervised hours and follow waterfront policies.

cards.title: Try a group fitness class
cards.subtitle: University Recreation & Wellness Center
cards.notes: Check the current recreation schedule, register when required, and choose a class that matches your comfort level for a structured campus activity.
cards.short_summary: Recurring recreation programming for the FGCU community.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU University Recreation & Wellness states that it offers group fitness classes free to the FGCU community.
cards.access_notes: Offerings and registration requirements vary; verify the current schedule before attending.

cards.title: Plan a pool visit
cards.subtitle: Lee County/FGCU Aquatics Center
cards.notes: Bring your Eagle ID, check lane availability, and follow lifeguard direction if you want an active break at the campus pool complex.
cards.short_summary: A campus aquatics complex with lap and recreational pool facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says students can access the Lee County/FGCU Aquatics Center using their Eagle ID; the facility includes a 50-meter pool and a 25-yard pool/diving well.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Center | FGCU University Recreation & Wellness
cards.access_notes: Check current hours and daily lane availability; pool use requires lifeguard supervision.

cards.title: See where Eagle spirit gathers
cards.subtitle: Alico Arena
cards.notes: Walk through the arena area, then check the official athletics or campus calendar before making plans around a game or student event.
cards.short_summary: An FGCU landmark tied to major student gatherings and commencements.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU documents Alico Arena as the site of Eagle Revolution, a first-day school-spirit event, and says students start and end their collegiate journey there.
cards.source_title: Presidential Installation Ceremony of President Aysegul Timur
cards.access_notes: Event access, tickets, and schedules vary; confirm details on the applicable official event listing.

cards.title: Take the boardwalk route
cards.subtitle: North Lake Village waterfront
cards.notes: Use the boardwalk as a daylight campus walk between the garage area and arena surroundings, pausing only in public, open areas.
cards.short_summary: A named campus walking route beside North Lake Village.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU’s commencement directions describe a half-mile walk along the boardwalk from Garage 1 toward Alico Arena.
cards.access_notes: Use open pedestrian routes and observe posted campus-access and weather guidance.

cards.title: Connect campus to Southwest Florida water
cards.subtitle: The Water School, FGCU main campus
cards.notes: Read the school’s current research and outreach overview, then use it as a prompt to notice the water and habitat systems around campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic hub for water-related research and engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says The Water School combines environmental sciences with social sciences, health sciences, business, and engineering and builds on water-related research and outreach.
cards.access_notes: This card suggests learning from public institutional materials; building access may depend on university operations.

cards.title: End outside at the union lawn
cards.subtitle: Outside Cohen Student Union
cards.notes: Finish the loop at the renovated lawn area and use the union’s event information to decide whether there is a public campus activity to attend.
cards.short_summary: An updated outdoor student space at the center of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU reported that Cohen Student Union renovations improved the lawn area to create a more engaging and functional outdoor space for students.
cards.source_title: Ribbon-cutting ceremony at the Cohen Student Union
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access and programming are subject to campus operations and weather.
